verdict.rationale: Linear's docs explicitly state that during a coding session Linear Agent 'detects and installs the toolchains and dependencies it needs to complete the task,' and further allow teams to pin runtime versions, add setup scripts, and define environment variables for finer control. This directly matches the story of an agent auto-detecting/installing toolchains. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond first-party changelog claims, and more detail on failure handling when auto-detection fails.
